limits: Editor modifications were unsaved; no native editor Save was tested. WP-CLI staged save and block roundtrip are separate evidence.

Raw compact markup normalizes in Gutenberg serialization. Unsaved dirty state can remain after restoring semantically identical blocks. Original database fingerprint was verified after browser closure and owned-user/lock cleanup.
Editor static responses were cached byte-for-byte within this run; no production performance claim.
Two external origins requested by the native editor were blocked; no external account/avatar/CDN data was sent.
This harness has clone-specific fixture IDs and a fixed loopback URL; never copy fixture IDs to production. Native identity/egress verification and disposable editor ownership must precede it.
